blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Mass / Story

blocks.source: 「スクウェア＋堀井雄二＋鳥山明」の看板を掲げたSFC後期の傑作。実際は堀井氏はシナリオ原案＆監修という程度とか……。
blocks.translation: A masterpiece from the late SFC era bearing the names “Square + Yuji Horii + Akira Toriyama.” In reality, Mr. Horii’s involvement apparently amounted to the original scenario concept and supervision…

blocks.source: 様々な時代を移動し、１９９９年の世界崩壊を阻止するという壮大なストーリー。当時、流行ったノストラダムスの予言ネタが、元になっている辺りに時代を感じる。
blocks.translation: An epic story about traveling through various eras to prevent the collapse of the world in 1999. The fact that it was based on the Nostradamus prophecies that were popular at the time really shows its era.

blocks.source: タイムパラドックスを物語上、都合良く解釈している箇所（最初の中世のイベント）が見られる。とはいえ、ドラえもんと同じで、この辺をあまり細かく突っ込むのは野暮かも。
blocks.translation: There are parts where time paradoxes are interpreted conveniently for the story (such as the first medieval event). Still, like Doraemon, it may be uncouth to scrutinize this sort of thing too closely.

blocks.source: 物語は流れるようにテンポ良く進む。中世や古代の展開は『魔王』『聖剣』『古代文明』など王道で期待を裏切らない。小ネタが豊富で、後半はクリアに必須ではないサブイベントも多い。
blocks.translation: The story progresses smoothly and at a brisk pace. The medieval and ancient developments follow classic themes such as the “Demon King,” “sacred sword,” and “ancient civilization,” without disappointing expectations. There are plenty of amusing little details, and the latter half contains many side events that are not required for completion.

blocks.source: 町は少なめで、ダンジョンは短め。特にダンジョンは、普通にやって５～１５分程度でクリアできるものが多数存在する。筆者の初回プレイでは、サブイベントをほぼ完了した上でも２０時間程度でクリア。SFCの有名RPGの中では、FF4と並んで短い部類。ただし、ラストダンジョンはかなり長く、２０時間の内の３～５時間程度は、これだったような記憶がある。
blocks.translation: There are relatively few towns, and the dungeons are short. In particular, many dungeons can be cleared in about 5–15 minutes through normal play. On my first playthrough, I cleared the game in about 20 hours even after completing nearly all the side events. Among famous SFC RPGs, it is on the shorter side, alongside FF4. However, the final dungeon is quite long, and I seem to remember that about 3–5 of those 20 hours were spent there.

blocks.source: ゲーム中盤から、ラスボスにいつでも挑めるのだが、倒した時期によって、エンディングは複数のパターンに変化する。しっかりしたものから、一発ネタ的なものまで色々。『強くてニューゲーム』によって、２周目が可能なので、それを利用して各エンディングを見ることができる。
blocks.translation: From the middle of the game onward, you can challenge the final boss at any time, but the ending changes among multiple patterns depending on when you defeat it. They range from substantial endings to one-off joke endings. Since “New Game Plus” allows you to play a second time, you can use it to view each ending.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: ダンジョンを移動する敵に近づくと、そのままスムーズに戦闘へ移行するのが特徴。シンボルエンカウントとは違って場所によっては、戦闘回避が不可能だが、頻度はそこまで高くない。難易度はやや低め。それほど手応えは無いが、安定している。
blocks.translation: A defining feature is that approaching an enemy moving around a dungeon smoothly transitions directly into battle. Unlike symbol encounters, avoiding battle is impossible in some areas, but they are not particularly frequent. The difficulty is somewhat low. It is not especially challenging, but it is well balanced.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムはFFシリーズと同じATB（アクティブタイムバトル）。FF5,6辺りと比較すると、若干戦闘テンポは遅めながらも、色々と進化が見られる。
blocks.translation: The battle system uses the same ATB (Active Time Battle) system as the FF series. Compared with around FF5 and FF6, the battle tempo is slightly slower, but there are various signs of evolution.

blocks.source: 具体的には……
blocks.translation: Specifically…

blocks.source: 位置の概念。敵が密集している場合は、範囲攻撃で一掃できる。
blocks.translation: The concept of positioning. When enemies are clustered together, they can be wiped out with area attacks.

blocks.source: ただし、味方は位置の変更が不可能。
blocks.translation: However, allies cannot change their positions.

blocks.source: タイムゲージが溜まったキャラクターが複数いる場合は左右で切替可能。
blocks.translation: When multiple characters have full time gauges, you can switch between them with left and right.

blocks.source: メンバーの組み合わせによって合体技が使用可能。
blocks.translation: Combination techniques can be used depending on the party member combination.

blocks.source: いずれの要素もFF7～9のATBに、取り入れられていないのは勿体ない……。
blocks.translation: It is a shame that none of these elements were incorporated into the ATB systems of FF7–9…

blocks.source: 最終的なパーティメンバーは７人。その中から３人の戦闘メンバーを編成可能。
blocks.translation: There are seven party members in total. You can form a battle party of three from among them.

blocks.source: 強化システム
blocks.translation: Enhancement System

blocks.source: 成長・強化システムはFF5,6と比較すると物足りない。『レベル』『装備』といった一般的な要素の他には、戦闘で得た『技ポイント』によって、技を修得するというシステムがある。『ジョブアビリティ』『魔石』程の深みは無く、単にレベルアップと技の習得を切り離したという程度の印象。
blocks.translation: The growth and enhancement system feels lacking compared with FF5 and FF6. In addition to standard elements such as “levels” and “equipment,” there is a system in which Techs are learned using “Tech Points” earned in battle. It lacks the depth of “Job Abilities” or “Magicite,” and gives the impression that leveling up and learning Techs were simply separated.

blocks.source: 装備や回復アイテムは宝箱から、次々と手に入るので、お金に不足することはまず無い。後半はザコ敵からラストエリクサー（全体HPMP全回復）ですら簡単に盗めてしまう。お金と店の役目はFFシリーズよりも更に薄い。ひょっとしたら店を縛っても余裕で進めるぐらいの調整かも。
blocks.translation: Equipment and healing items are obtained one after another from treasure chests, so you will rarely be short on money. In the latter half, you can even easily steal Elixirs (fully restore the entire party’s HP and MP) from regular enemies. Money and shops play an even smaller role than in the FF series. The game may even be balanced so that you could comfortably progress while avoiding shops altogether.

blocks.source: 上記の通り、次々とストーリーを進行させるには快適だが、あまり試行錯誤せずとも先に進めてしまうので、手応えを求めるプレイヤーは物足りなさを感じるかもしれない。一応、ラスボスなど一部のボスはそこそこ手強い。
blocks.translation: As mentioned above, the game is comfortable for advancing through the story one event after another, but since you can progress without much trial and error, players looking for a challenge may find it lacking. That said, some bosses, including the final boss, are reasonably tough.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: SFC最高峰のグラフィックの１つ。原始の森～崩壊した未来まで、時代によって雰囲気の異なるマップが描かれる。
blocks.translation: One of the finest examples of SFC graphics. From the prehistoric forest to the ruined future, maps with distinct atmospheres are depicted for each era.

blocks.source: FF1～6と違って、仲間キャラクターには上下の動作アニメーションがあるので、ドットを打つのは大変だったと思う。戦闘アニメーションは１人技～３人技まで数豊富。
blocks.translation: Unlike FF1–6, the party characters have up-and-down movement animations, so creating all those sprites must have been difficult. There are numerous battle animations, ranging from solo Techs to three-person Techs.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 光田康典氏のデビュー作。デビュー作といっても、曲の水準は非常に高い。ちなみに植松伸夫氏や松枝賀子氏（バハムートラグーンとか）も参加していたりする。
blocks.translation: Yasunori Mitsuda’s debut work. Although it was his debut, the quality of the music is exceptionally high. Incidentally, Nobuo Uematsu and Noriko Matsueda (of Bahamut Lagoon, among others) also took part.

blocks.source: 古代や中世のフィールド曲は歴代ゲーム音楽の中でも有数の人気を誇る名曲。通常戦闘曲はちょっと地味だが、ボス戦曲は充実。特に魔王戦やラスボス第２形態は壮大かつ格好いい。
blocks.translation: The ancient and medieval field themes are masterpieces renowned as some of the most popular in video game music history. The regular battle theme is somewhat understated, but the boss battle themes are excellent. In particular, the Demon King battle and the final boss’s second form are epic and stylish.
